description: Find and replace text in an existing .docx document. Useful for template substitution — e.g., replacing {{CLIENT_NAME}} with an actual name, or updating dates and contract values.

filePath.description: Path to the .docx file to modify

replace.description: Replacement text (can be empty string to delete the found text)

replaceAll.description: If true (default), replace every occurrence. If false, replace only the first occurrence.

name: replace_text
